item.title: Radiation victims in St. Louis can now file claims online
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice has launched an online portal for victims of radioactive waste in the St. Louis region to formally submit their RECA claims.

item.title: St. Louis City provides update on snow removal
item.description: With it being nearly a week since a winter storm came into the St. Louis area, Mayor Cara Spencer held a press conference Thursday, sharing updates on the city's progress in removing the snow.

item.title: Man gunned down for honking at pedestrians on the road, police say
item.description: A Ferguson man has been charged with shooting and killing a driver who honked their car horn at him.

item.title: Illinois reverend accused of producing child porn
item.description: A reverend and church official from Springfield, Illinois, appeared in federal court Thursday after being arrested for filming underage children.

item.title: Water main breaks leave STL neighborhood with little to no water
item.description: Residents in Tower Grove Heights said they are doing what they can to get by as repeated water main breaks leave parts of the neighborhood with little to no running water.

item.title: A dangerous, drug-resistant fungus is spreading in Missouri health care facilities
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — The Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services (DHSS) says it continues to detect a rising number of cases of the drug-resistant fungus Candida auris in health care facilities across the state, prompting renewed guidance for hospitals, nursing homes and other providers. item.title: Mayor Cara Spencer backs immigrants amid ICE tensions
item.description: In the wake of widespread protests following two deadly shootings at the hands of federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Minneapolis, St. Louis Mayor Cara Spencer is weighing in on the matter.

item.title: Attorney questions ISP shooting in East St. Louis
item.description: For the first time since the Jan. 4 Illinois State Police (ISP) shooting of Rachel Tarrence, her family's attorney weighs in on the case.

item.title: Helicopter crashes, lands in Meramec River; 4 escape with 'minor injuries'
item.description: A helicopter crashed Thursday afternoon and ended up in a river at Meramec State Park, officials tell FOX 2.

item.title: Suspect arrested for Ferguson mortuary shooting
item.description: A Jennings, Missouri, man is in custody for participating in Wednesday’s shooting at a Ferguson mortuary that injured multiple people.
